offers_products.reason: Sells hamburgers, chicken sandwiches, fries and beverages as food products; franchisees also buy brand and supply system.

offers_services.reason: Operates restaurants with drive-thru and delivery service; also franchising services to franchisees (royalties, support).

sells_to_consumers.reason: Fast-food restaurants serve individual diners via drive-thru, delivery and app rewards.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Franchise owners are business customers buying franchise rights; seeks new franchise owners.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly franchise royalties and repeat restaurant sales of burgers and meals from habitual customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-priced fast-food meals are resilient in downturns; diners often trade down to value burgers.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a small, frequent meal purchase of burgers, fries and drinks.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for food, brand and restaurant locations; franchise royalties are the main earnings, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households and individual franchisees, not large enterprises or government agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly franchised, asset-light model collecting royalties; franchisees own most restaurants, though company runs some.

notes: Mostly franchised; answers reflect the franchisor model plus consumer restaurant sales.
